text: I came across this video a week ago when it was recommended to me by YT, and I can probably thank my mini-infatuation with 5SOS's recent album as well as my occasional listen to Home Run for that. And man am I thankful. The way he dances is so bewitching, every time I watch it it feels like the first. There's so much energy and power in his movements but that doesn't take away any of the storytelling either. I adore the set too, how it looks like he's trapped - and for the first part, he dances like he's attempting to fight or wrestle with some love; in the second, it's almost like he's surrendered and made into a puppet. I've since branched out and watched more performances and videos but I can't help coming back to this video over and over again. He's so unbelievably captivating, I feel like I'm the one being trapped instead.
